rv.q: But it made me laugh out loud more often than just about anything else I’ve seen in the last 12 months and the characters are charming and winningly delineated.
However, for bungling wit matched with peerless physical comedy, you'd be hard pressed to find better in the West End.
Politically correct it certainly isn’t, but huge fun it definitely is.
This is an evening of daft, uncomplicated fun.
This is clearly going to be an enormous popular hit.
This finely tuned machine of comic timing and theatrical chaos is possibly Mischief’s best work yet, offering audiences exactly what they have come to expect – and love – from this troupe.
